control_164525233292.note: Authoritative senior-supplied control, reproduced from raw before any rebuild.

metric_definitions.orders: COUNT(DISTINCT order_management.orders.order_id) via order_item_info at account+item+marketplace, EBAY source, status NOT IN (Cancelled,Refunded), order_id non-blank. NOT quantity_sold, NOT item_quantity, NOT order-line count.
metric_definitions.sales: SUM(item_quantity * item_price) over the SAME valid-order population as Orders.
metric_definitions.ly_ad_generated: AD_FEE (Promoted Standard) matched on (order_id, item_id) to the purchased order line; the VALUE is that line's realised revenue, never the fee. No fee-date window is applied -- eBay bills on its own clock and order 11-13519-57563 (placed 2025-09-01) was billed 2025-08-31.
metric_definitions.orders_total_caveat: Summing the Orders column across rows is a sum of PER-LISTING order counts, not a count of distinct orders at account or portfolio level: one order containing two different assigned listings contributes 1 to each row. This is inherent to a per-listing report and is why account/category subtotals here are sums of row values.
